question: Which usage count does the Beams Sandbox cap of 1,000 use today? The pricing page tooltip, the subscribers docs and the plan-limit article count concurrent subscribers across all instances for a given day, and a 2020 vendor post says this replaced Monthly Active Devices. The docs page https://pusher.com/docs/beams/concepts/active-devices/ still bills a Free plan on Monthly Active Devices over the most recent 30 days, and an older tutorial says up to 1000 devices during a billing month. dev-services/pusher-beams follows the pricing page.
why: two first-party counts disagree; the usage panel of a live Beams instance in the dashboard would show which one the Sandbox cap enforces
